notes.title: 7/10「happy birthday to Haru！」
notes.content:
記憶的怪物-命運的抉擇-》STEAM版
7月10日「專暑千晴祭」限時優惠！FB粉專送好禮！
熱情如火的七月迎接
專暑千晴祭活動
STEAM限時75折♬

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39115126/e82f2559fc207ce323b204c48d29d1bf7b304e6d.jpg[/img]

改編自東立暢銷BL漫畫《記憶的怪物》的電玩遊戲《記憶的怪物-命運的抉擇-》，自2020年推出以來便獲得廣大好評，除了唯美的BL元素之外，細膩又深刻的劇情也是一大特點。原作不僅逆輸出至日本，也曾推出小說、畫冊、主題特展以及合作咖啡，不斷創新IP價值；今年2月也釋出了LINE貼圖，讓Q版主角們融入日常生活的對話中，讓粉絲們愛不釋手。《記憶的怪物》這波熱潮尚未平息，可望再有新一波的合作開發。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39115126/b291ad3039466c3312617d004b5bae2b9bc0324a.jpg[/img]

7月10日迎來主角千晴的生日，官方推出了「專暑千晴祭」，Steam版遊戲再開優惠，自7/10起至7/23止，為期兩週，限時75折！遊戲的FB粉絲專頁也將舉辦抽獎活動，喜歡《記憶的怪物》的朋友千萬別錯過喔！

notes.title: 《THE MONSTER OF MEMORY:DESTINY》Now On Steam !!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39115126/a37a8365c3ef617a071010ef53cb4f9904c101fe.jpg[/img]

Thank everyone's support,
the game is officially released tonight.
Hope you can enjoy this game!!

[b]Memory... Does it represent all a person has?[/b]

A railway accident changed Sumi's life... Aiming to be like his brother, Haru, he applied to a special agency for intelligent creatures ── RE614.
What kind of impact will this creature, with the same appearance as his brother, give to Sumi?

==========

Winning the 8th Golden Manga Award in Taiwan, Visual novel "THE MONSTER OF MEMORY:DESTINY" has been adapted from the manga of the same name!

●featuring 16 full-colour CGs from the original manga to retain the original flavour, and a total of more than 700 images including costumes, poses and expressions of eight unique characters

●All roles fully voiced in Chinese by a local professional team

●Written by "Purple Day", a well-known light novel author

●In addition to the manga being completely represented in the form of a visual novel, three new plots and memories have been added

==========
